viv: Quick report: different SDKs behaving differently on streaming parity. Browser (EventSource) and Go SDK show occasional out-of-order SSE chunks under a throttled proxy. Python looks OK.
amar: do you have logs? which transport and any reconnects?
viv: EventSource in sampleapp + our go client. Repro by throttling to ~100kbps via `tc qdisc netem` and forcing a token refresh mid-stream. Logs show: 
```
[13:10:01] ordinal=1 data=\"Hi\"
[13:10:04] ordinal=4 data=\".\"
[13:10:07] ordinal=2 data=\", folks\"
[13:10:08] ordinal=3 data=\" thanks\"
```
No HTTP errors. Go client logs show a reconnect at 13:10:05 but browser didn't show a reconnect.
zoe: interesting parity bug. Go client uses a reconnect backoff that waits for drain; browser opens a fresh ES connection immediately. That difference could explain interleaving if runtime replays buffered events on reconnect.
amar: runtime note: we currently don't attach a resume token for EventSource; we can add `X-Chunk-Ordinal` header and `X-Stream-Id` per flush. That gives clients a deterministic key to reorder.
viv: short-term mitigation I validated: disable auto-reconnect in browser SDK and increase reconnect jitter in Go client. Both reduce occurrences.
zoe: long-term: add `chunk_ordinal` (monotonic integer) in the SSE `id:` line or `X-Chunk-Ordinal` header. SDKs should expose `reorder_on_ordinal:true` config and emit telemetry when reorder happens.
amar: also add a debug trace on the server when it replays buffered fragments so we can correlate `stream-id` + `ordinal` pairs.
viv: I'll add a tiny sampleapp test using nghttp2 to force H2 frame splits + `tc netem` to throttle and a token refresh at 3s. Will include a minimal repro script: `./scripts/repro/throttle-and-refresh.sh`.
zoe: QA ask: please add an e2e that asserts final assembled text equals ordered ordinals 1..N. Put it in sampleapp/ci/streaming-reorder.spec.
infra-bot: opened infra ticket #6066 "streaming: add chunk ordinal + stream id; SDK reorder option" https://git.redwood/infra/issues/6066 :robot_face:
devx-bot: created SDK task #2289 "browser: add reorder_on_ordinal flag + diagnostic metric" https://git.redwood/sdk/issues/2289 :robot_face:
viv: thanks all. i'll push repro + a tiny patch to browser SDK behind a feature flag and link both tickets. :thumbsup:
